---
title: "World Flags"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(countrycode)

# List all flag image files in the data directory
flag_files <- list.files("data", pattern = "\\.png$")
flag_codes <- sub("\\.png$", "", flag_files)

# Map ISO codes to country names
flags_df <- tibble(
  code = flag_codes,
  country = countrycode(
    toupper(code),
    origin = "iso2c",
    destination = "country.name",
    custom_match = c(
      "GB-ENG" = "England",
      "GB-NIR" = "Northern Ireland",
      "GB-SCT" = "Scotland",
      "GB-WLS" = "Wales",
      "XK" = "Kosovo"
    )
  ),
  file = paste0("data/", flag_files)
) |>
  drop_na(country) |>
  arrange(country)

# Pass data to Observable JS
ojs_define(flags_data = flags_df)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
flags = transpose(flags_data)

viewof selected = Inputs.select(
  flags,
  {
    label: "Select a country:",
    format: d => d.country,
    value: flags.find(d => d.country === "United States")
  }
)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<div style="margin-top: 1.5em;">
  <h3>${selected.country}</h3>
  <img src="${selected.file}" alt="${selected.country} flag" style="max-width: 450px; border: 1px solid #ccc; border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);" />
</div>`
```
